title: DSPkit: a digital signal processing toolkit for time series data
description:
DSPkit is a Python library for digital signal processing of time series data, built on NumPy and SciPy.

It covers spectral estimation (FFT, Welch PSD, CSD, coherence, autocorrelation), filtering, time-frequency analysis (STFT, CWT, Wigner-Ville, smoothed-pseudo WVD, Fourier synchrosqueezing), instantaneous quantities via the Hilbert transform, empirical mode decomposition and the Hilbert-Huang transform, peak detection, multi-channel relationships including multiple and partial coherence, mutual information, distribution and normality analysis, and Frequency Domain Decomposition for modal parameters.

The API is function-based and depends only on NumPy, SciPy and Matplotlib.
